implemented: Two resolved origin echoes unlock The Museum That Refused to Stay Put; found-but-unresolved echoes do not count.
One moving cart grows from two to five centered, origin-shaped exhibits in authored definition order and remains derived from the resolved world ledger after equipment is gone.
The parade follows a deterministic bounded dry-meadow loop by day and parks at the fixed visible (-6, 30) civic berth at night.
Arbiter-0 names every represented robot steward, installation and region. The interaction grants no reward, creates no repeat chore, consumes no item and changes no currency.
A twelve-meter moving civic sanctuary suspends ordinary enemy aggression while the cart is present.
The full world map exposes one moving-museum marker, and direct runtime datasets expose mode, exhibit count and position for honest live verification.
